records.source: 'The Solarion Chronicles'
records.translation: 《索拉里昂編年史》

records.source: It's full of empty beer bottles.
records.translation: 裡面裝滿空啤酒瓶。

records.source: 'Fairys, Junimos, and other Fables'
records.translation: 《仙子、祝尼魔與其他寓言》

records.source: Whoever lives here must really like a clean floor!
records.translation: 住在這裡的人一定非常喜歡乾淨的地板！

records.source: It would probably be a bad idea to stick your tender arm in there.
records.translation: 把你柔嫩的手臂伸進去大概不是好主意。

records.source: The bone is probably covered in bacteria. You decide not to touch it.
records.translation: 骨頭上大概布滿細菌。你決定不要觸碰。

records.source: You uncork the bottle and waft the odor into your nostrils. The odor is surprisingly pleasant, with hints of apricot and spice berry.
records.translation: 你拔開瓶塞，將氣味搧向鼻孔。這股味道出乎意料地宜人，帶著淡淡的杏桃和香料莓香氣。

records.source: Curse The Countryside!... A Spellbook For The Rural Witch
records.translation: 詛咒鄉間！……鄉村女巫的法術書

records.source: You try not to make eye contact...
records.translation: 你儘量避開視線接觸……

records.source: Crane Man: Can't talk... I'm in the zone.
records.translation: 夾娃娃機男子：不能說話……我正進入狀態。

records.source: The crane game is in use by someone else.
records.translation: 其他人正在使用夾娃娃機。

records.source: Crane Man: Almost... got it...
records.translation: 夾娃娃機男子：就差一點……夾到了……

records.source: Welwick: Hmm, not many people here... and I invested a lot of money in this movie!
records.translation: 韋爾維克：嗯，這裡沒多少人……我可是為這部電影投資了很多錢！

records.source: Welwick: I foresee great things in your future... If you buy lots of tickets to this movie!
records.translation: 韋爾維克：我預見你的未來將有好事發生……只要你買很多這部電影的票！

records.source: Corner Guy: Brr... it's kind of drafty over here... I'm glad I wore my long pants!
records.translation: 角落男子：噗嚕嚕……這裡有點漏風……幸好我穿了長褲！

records.source: Corner Guy: Psst... I just saw the movie, and... Relax! I'm not going to spoil it for you.
records.translation: 角落男子：噓……我剛看完電影，而且……放輕鬆！我不會向你爆雷。

records.source: Woman: Simon, don't you want something healthy? *sigh*... okay...
records.translation: 女人：賽門，不想吃點健康的東西嗎？*嘆氣*……好吧……

records.source: Woman: How about some apple slices? No? *sigh*... okay...
records.translation: 女人：來點蘋果片怎麼樣？不要？*嘆氣*……好吧……

records.source: Simon: Mom! I want candy! *slurp*
records.translation: 賽門：媽媽！我要吃糖果！*吸口水*

records.source: Simon: Mom! I want chocolate popcorn! *slurp*
records.translation: 賽門：媽媽！我要吃巧克力爆米花！*吸口水*

records.source: Lupini: Amateurs! The set design was completely mundane!
records.translation: 盧皮尼：業餘貨色！布景設計完全平庸！

records.source: Lupini: Amateurs! My nephew's 2nd birthday party home video had better cinematography!
records.translation: 盧皮尼：業餘貨色！我外甥兩歲生日派對的家庭錄影，攝影都比這更好！

records.source: Moviegoer: Urgh... Too many snack options!
records.translation: 觀眾：呃……點心選擇太多了！

records.source: Moviegoer: Ah, look at that popcorn go! Oh, the sounds... the smells!
records.translation: 觀眾：啊，看那些爆米花不停跳動！喔，這聲音……這香氣！

records.source: Woman: Get lost... I'm busy rubbing elbows with the Governor!
records.translation: 女人：走開……我正忙著和州長攀交情！

records.source: Man: Uh oh... I think I'm a little overdressed for this place...
records.translation: 男人：糟糕……我好像穿得太正式了……

records.source: Man: I sat in the front row... big mistake.
records.translation: 男人：我坐在第一排……大錯特錯。

records.source: Governor: It's lovely to see economic development in the valley!
records.translation: 州長：很高興看到山谷的經濟發展！

records.source: Governor: I really must bring the missus out for soup and a movie!
records.translation: 州長：我真的得帶太太來喝湯、看電影！

records.source: Hey, I'd love to chat, but I need to head back to the museum!
records.translation: 嘿，我很想聊聊，不過得趕回博物館！

records.source: Hey, @. I just saw the movie, myself... not bad!
records.translation: 嘿，@。我也剛看完電影……還不錯！

records.source: Gil slept through the whole movie... typical.
records.translation: 吉爾整部電影都在睡覺……一如往常。

records.source: That was an interesting one... what'd you think, Gil?#$b#...Gil?#$b#...He's out cold.
records.translation: 這部片挺有意思……你覺得呢，吉爾？#$b#……吉爾？#$b#……他睡死了。

records.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the bourbon mayonnaise. Hehe!
records.translation: 馬切洛：好豐盛！我想選波本美乃滋。嘿嘿！

records.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the 12-grain spicy mustard. Hehe!
records.translation: 馬切洛：好豐盛！我想選十二穀辣芥末。嘿嘿！

records.source: As you can see, the theater is a major success!$h#$b#Whaa...? A return on your investment? Well, it's difficult, you know... might take a while, you understand... *mumble*$2
records.translation: 如你所見，電影院大獲成功！$h#$b#什麼……？投資回報？嗯，這很複雜，你知道……可能還要一段時間，明白吧……*含糊嘀咕*$2

records.source: Ah, it's our very important investment partner! Enjoy the show, and don't forget to buy a bag of JojaCorn on your way in!$h
records.translation: 啊，是我們非常重要的投資夥伴！好好享受電影，進場時別忘了買一袋 Joja 爆米花！$h

records.source: Play the Crane Game? (Costs {0}g)
records.translation: 要玩夾娃娃機嗎？（費用：{0}g）

records.source: When dark clouds cry, begin your quest^To seek the fabled gem-birds four^Each day, one north, south, east, or west^Arrange their gifts upon my door
records.translation: 當烏雲哭泣，踏上旅程^尋覓傳說中的四隻寶石鳥^每日一隻，來自東南西北^將牠們的贈禮置於我門前

records.source: GREEN: You were always Momma's favorite! WaaaAaAa
records.translation: 綠衣海盜：媽媽一直都最疼你！哇啊啊啊

records.source: RED: Mamma mia! Calm down, brother. Youch!
records.translation: 紅衣海盜：我的媽呀！冷靜點，兄弟。哎喲！

records.source: WELL-DRESSED PIRATE: *ahem*... Yar.#...#...Not convincing, huh?#*sigh*...#To tell you the truth, I don't really want to be a pirate. I'd rather grow palms.#Unfortunately, there's no money in the palm business...
records.translation: 衣著體面的海盜：*清喉嚨*……呀。#……#……不太像，對吧？#*嘆氣*……#老實說，我並不是真的想當海盜。我寧願種棕櫚樹。#可惜，棕櫚生意賺不到錢……

records.source: BLACKGULL: Yar, matey. Ye must have a keen eye to've spotted our secret cove. Yo ho!
records.translation: 黑鷗：呀，夥伴。你能發現我們的祕密海灣，眼睛一定很尖。喲吼！

records.source: GRIM PIRATE: From yonder seas, a chilling tale, a nightmare sure to haunt your sleep...#'Twas midnight when I lost me hands... to a savage monster o' the deep...#Yar, 'tis true...#...#...#..............#..............................................#Alright, I'm just kidding. I actually lost them while trying to fish an eggshell out of the blender.#Alas... me famous cake batter days are over...
records.translation: 陰沉海盜：來自遠方海洋的悚人故事，一場必將糾纏你夢境的惡夢……#午夜時分，我的雙手被……深海中的兇猛怪物奪走……#呀，這是真的……#……#……#………………#…………………………………………………………#好吧，我只是開玩笑。其實是伸手想從果汁機裡撈出蛋殼時弄丟的。#唉……我製作知名蛋糕麵糊的日子結束了……

records.source: He's in a stupor...
records.translation: 他神智恍惚……

records.source: BARTENDER: Oi guv!... Grog and tasties are fer da pirates only.
records.translation: 酒保：嘿，老兄！……烈酒和美食只招待海盜。

records.source: DART MAN: Care for a game o' darts? You've got 20 darts to score exactly 301 points.
records.translation: 飛鏢手：想玩一場飛鏢嗎？你有二十支飛鏢，必須正好得到 301 分。

records.source: DART MAN: How about we make things more interesting. Hit exactly 301 points within 15 darts and I'll be impressed, matey!
records.translation: 飛鏢手：來讓事情更有意思吧。用十五支飛鏢正好得到 301 分，我就服你，夥伴！

records.source: DART MAN: Ah, good to see ya again, matey! Let's see if you can score 301 points within... 10 darts!
records.translation: 飛鏢手：啊，很高興又見到你，夥伴！看看能不能用……十支飛鏢得到 301 分！

records.source: DART MAN: Ahoy! If it isn't me matey... ol' steady-hands! How about a game o' darts for old times' sake?
records.translation: 飛鏢手：啊嘿！這不是我的夥伴……老穩手嗎！念在往日情誼，再來一場飛鏢如何？
